## Structure Rules

- This backlog implements the approved Option B scope only.
- Every item maps to an approved requirement, operational deliverable, or acceptance activity.
- Individual owners remain `TBD` until separately assigned.
- RQ-17 (video protection) and RQ-18 (Microsoft 365 SSO) remain conditional.
- RQ-19 exclusions must not enter the backlog without an approved change.
- The administrator Classroom recordings page is approved under CHG-02 and must remain traceable to RQ-20.
- The prior WordPress backlog remains historical evidence and is not rewritten here.
- `Implemented locally` means the feature implementation and automated local checks are complete; browser, staging, and launch acceptance remain separate gates.
- CHG-27 (Add event-level email reminders to Lead Lab calendar events) is approved and must remain traceable to RQ-14 (The application should provide a calendar with scheduled events and configurable email reminders); local delivery evidence does not replace staging mail, queue, scheduler, or participant-data evidence.

## Delivery Sequence

1. Verify the environment and establish foundation/access.
2. Build the vertical slice across access, one session, video, protected material, and revocation.
3. Build classroom, including the administrator recordings page, search, and filters for the core training experience.
4. Build community, calendar, administration, moderation, and event reminders.
5. Load and verify September content.
6. Run security, responsive, feature, and participant testing.
7. Obtain final acceptance or activate the SharePoint fallback.
